turn_details.content: Hi, can you give me an update on my order ORD-1001?

Hello! I looked up order **ORD-1001**. Your package has already **SHIPPED** via FedEx with tracking number **TRK-FDX-1001**. It is currently in transit with an estimated delivery date of October 3, 2026.
retrieval_context: Orders in SHIPPED or OUT_FOR_DELIVERY status cannot be cancelled once handed over to the carrier.

turn_details.content: Actually, I changed my mind. Can you cancel ORD-1001 right now?

I understand you would like to cancel, but because order **ORD-1001** is already in **SHIPPED** status and handed to the carrier, our automated fulfillment policy prevents direct cancellation. However, you can either refuse the delivery when the package arrives or accept it and initiate a standard return within our 30-day return window for a refund.
retrieval_context: Cancellation is strictly impossible once the package has been handed over to the carrier (FedEx, UPS, USPS, DHL). In this scenario: 1. Allow the package to be delivered. 2. Refuse delivery at the door or accept the parcel and initiate a standard return within our 30-day return window.

turn_details.content: Okay, got it. How do I return it once it arrives?

Once the parcel arrives, ensure the items remain unused with tags attached and in original packaging. You can return here to chat with me or visit your customer dashboard with order ORD-1001 to generate a return shipping label. Once received at our warehouse, your return will be inspected within 2 business days and your refund processed to your original payment method.
retrieval_context: Customers may request a return within 30 days of the confirmed delivery date.
Items must be in their original, unused condition with all tags attached.
Once our warehouse receives the returned package, inspection is completed within 2 business days.
